title: SeeDance 2.5 Flash
description: ByteDance SeeDance 2.5 Flash — the faster, lower-cost SeeDance 2.5 (about twice as fast), with generated sound. The same modes in one model: text-to-video; image-to-video (start + optional end frame); and reference-to-video mixing up to 10 reference images (free), up to 5 reference video clips (2-30s each, 30s combined — billed per second of INPUT, see POST /v1/cost) and up to 5 reference audio clips (2-30s each, 30s combined, free; audio-only input is supported). Video editing and extension are reference-video modes — no separate edit endpoint. Reference media can't be combined with start/end frames. 480p or 720p (no 1080p), any duration 4-30 seconds. Billed per second of output: 93 credits at 480p, 200 at 720p; reference-video input adds 57 per second at 480p and 123 at 720p. No draft mode (seedance-2.5 has it).

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio for text-to-video. Ignored (adaptive) when a start frame or any reference media sets the frame.

end_image.description: Optional end frame, used together with `image` (the start frame) to interpolate the video between the two frames. Same input forms as `image`.

generate_audio.description: Generate audio with the video (on unless set to false; no price impact).

image.description: Optional start frame for image-to-video. Provide a public image URL, a data URI, raw base64, or an uploaded-file URL from POST /v1/uploads. Omit for text-to-video. Can't be combined with reference media.

prompt.description: Text description of the video, including the sound you want. With reference videos, say what to do with them: edit or extend a clip, or take its motion or camera work. Write `@handle` to cast a character: a BudgetPixel AI influencer or one of your own ([`GET /v1/characters`](/api-reference/characters/list-characters-you-can-cast)).

reference_audios.description: Optional reference audio clips (up to 5; each 2-30s, 30s combined; WAV/MP3) that guide sound/voice. Audio-only input is supported. Each item is a public audio URL or an uploaded-file URL from POST /v1/uploads. Free — no input billing. Can't be combined with `image`/`end_image`.

reference_images.description: Optional reference images (up to 10, free) that guide identity/style in reference-to-video mode. Each item is a public image URL, a data URI, raw base64, or an uploaded-file URL from POST /v1/uploads. Can't be combined with `image`/`end_image`.

reference_videos.description: Optional reference video clips (up to 5; each 2-30s — a clip the prompt edits 4-30s — 30s combined; MP4/MOV, ≤50MB each) for editing, extension, and motion/identity guidance. Each item is a public video URL or an uploaded-file URL from POST /v1/uploads (videos are passed by URL, not inlined). Billed on the INPUT duration (57/sec at 480p, 123/sec at 720p) in addition to the output — estimate via POST /v1/cost. Can't be combined with `image`/`end_image`.

resolution.description: Output resolution, 480p or 720p (no 1080p: seedance-2.5 has it). Pricing varies by resolution — see `resolution_pricing` in GET /v1/models.
